summary: Iteration 3 verified: (a) full-year scaffolding — GET /api/years and /api/months?year=2026 return 12 months with is_template=true for Jan-Aug and paycheck-backed months for Sept-Dec; (b) POST /api/months/ensure-year is idempotent and validates range; (c) BUG FIX confirmed — GET /api/paychecks/{id}/savings-recommendation now returns net_after_obligations = total_cash - fixed_obligations (no double-subtraction of unpaid_bills) and non-zero conservative/balanced/aggressive plus a presets[] quick-picks array; (d) Goals CRUD + contribute (POST /goals, GET /goals, PATCH, DELETE, POST /goals/{id}/contribute) fully persistent — contributions accumulate; (e) GET /streak returns current_streak, best_streak, ytd_saved, message, monthly_saved; (f) regressions pass (seed idempotent, /summary, /months/{key}, /bills list). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed. Frontend (mobile 390x844): dashboard shows year chips + 12 month chips with template months rendered dim and empty-month card 'No paychecks in January 2026'; Tracker shows streak card with flame, YTD bento, year+month chips, inline goal previews, and Goals header button; Goals screen create/contribute flow works end-to-end; Paycheck detail 'Set savings' opens sheet with manual dollar TextInput, 6 presets ($25/$37/$50/$74/$100/$130 filtered by net), optional goal picker (only rendered when goals exist), and Apply button that PATCHes savings_transfer. No red screens, no deprecated packages, no React Native issues. Only benign expo-notifications web warning.

issues: Bottom sheet extends below the viewport on 390x844; 'save-goal' button requires scroll_into_view before it becomes visible. Not blocking (KeyboardAvoidingView handles it on real device), but consider making the sheet scrollable or capping form height.

Default selected year on load is the most recent (2027) rather than the current year (2026). Users must tap 2026 to see September data. Consider defaulting to a year that actually has paychecks, or to the current year.

action_items: Optional: default dashboard/tracker to the current year (or the latest year with paychecks) instead of the max year in /api/years. Currently the 'year-chip-*' auto-selects 2027 which is empty.
Optional: make the goal-form-sheet scrollable so 'save-goal' is visible without manual scrolling on shorter viewports (390x844).
Optional: on iteration_2 note — 'Bills' bottom tab label still doesn't match its 'Calendar' screen header; carry-over cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan when convenient.
server.py is 866 lines — still under 1000 but approaching the split threshold; consider extracting Goals + Streak into a module.
_ensure_year_months does N find_one + insert_one calls per year; acceptable for 12 rows but could be a single insert_many with a pre-filter for scale.
savings_streak() aggregates paychecks per-month in a Python loop — for larger datasets an $facet/aggregate pipeline would be preferable.
Frontend api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL directly (fine, but no fallback assertion) — a missing env would silently produce '/api/*' relative requests.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Test goals prefixed TEST_UI_* were created and deleted through DELETE /api/goals/{id}. A test PATCH set paycheck 3 savings_transfer to 75 (previous value shown was $0); may need reset if visuals matter for demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (17 tests, ~1.6s). BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env (public preview). Frontend testIDs added this iteration: year-chip-{year}, month-chip-{key}, tracker-year-{year}, tracker-month-{key}, streak-card, open-goals, goals-screen, add-goal-btn, goal-form-sheet, input-goal-name, input-goal-target, icon-{i}, color-{name}, save-goal, delete-goal, goal-{id}, contribute-{id}, goal-preview-{id}, goal-empty, input-contribute, confirm-contribute, input-savings-amount, preset-{n}, goal-pick-none, goal-pick-{id}, apply-savings. Backend savings-recommendation returns presets[] filtered by net_after_obligations; goal picker on savings sheet only renders when goals exist (goal-pick-none testID is conditional).
rca_of_issue: Iteration 2 bug: savings-recommendation returned $0 because both fixed_obligations and unpaid_bills were subtracted from total_cash, but the aggregated buckets (vehicle_payment/targeted_payoffs/current_month_bills/next_month_early_bills/living_costs) already include those bills. FIX: server.py:606-607 now computes net_after_fixed = max(0, total_cash - fixed) only, and returns unpaid_bills as informational metadata. Verified for Sept paycheck 3 (total_cash=$1300, fixed=$929.55, net=$370.45, balanced=$74.09, presets=[25,37,50,74,100,130]).
